shortDescription: Configure NTP server, timezone, and daylight saving time on Huawei VRP

options.name: backup
options.description: Whether to create a local backup of the current configuration.

options.name: backup_path
options.description: Optional path on the controller to store the backup file.

options.name: disable_ipv4_server
options.description: Whether to disable the device's built-in IPv4 NTP server.

options.name: disable_ipv6_server
options.description: Whether to disable the device's built-in IPv6 NTP server.

options.name: dst_end
options.description: End time of DST in the format C(HH:MM YYYY-MM-DD). Must be provided together with C(dst_start).

options.name: dst_name
options.description: Name used for daylight saving time.

options.name: dst_offset
options.description: Time offset applied during DST (e.g., C(01:00)).

options.name: dst_start
options.description: Start time of DST in the format C(HH:MM YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, no daylight-saving-time configuration is applied.

options.name: manage_timezone
options.description: Whether to configure timezone and daylight-saving settings. If omitted, timezone is configured only when C(state=present) and relevant parameters are provided.

options.name: save_when
options.description: When to save the device configuration.

options.name: server
options.description: IP address or hostname of the NTP server.

options.name: source_interface
options.description: Optional source interface for outbound NTP packets.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the configuration should be present or removed (undo all).

options.name: timezone_offset
options.description: Offset in hours from UTC (e.g., C(1) for UTC+1).
